source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted folder checks for a non-empty incoming-server management URL when computing hasAdminUrl, and properties hides the Privileges control when that capability is false. The current browser test separately checks the hidden state with no URL and captures the external launch with a URL. For this control, preserve the capability and activation contract together. The legacy dotted DOM ID imap.FolderPrivileges remains a compatibility name, not a reason to introduce dotted IDs in new components. This is scoped source/test guidance; keyboard, real external launch and accessibility checks were not run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Folder privileges visibility and activation share the management-URL capability
